scope: Production TEE pose geometry, actual DOM events and shared worker contracts; not clinical registration, browser performance or contact-force validation.
checks: ME 0°, 90°, 120° and distal short-axis references match the existing source sections to submicrometre numerical tolerance; named anatomy remains approximate.
Multiplane controls leave tip, shaft and central beam fixed; 180° mirrors the in-plane side without changing the physical section.
Insertion translates along the reference tract; shaft turn changes mechanical facing; independent flexions bend and displace the tip. Every basis remains orthonormal.
All three donor paths remain finite and continuous and comparison-donor imaging depths retain their calibrated entries.

Actual TEE controls, lock, presets and IDs remain independent when Probe Lab is also mounted. Locking stops manual steering but allows imaging changes; starting views and Reset explicitly establish an unlocked reference pose. The authored tract remains labeled illustrative and unregistered.
Focused keyboard motion is TEE-only and clears on blur, lock, Escape and exit; exit aborts pending fine source work.
Production CT/acoustic computation retains all TEE fields and identical accepted cap/image/pose; requested motion cannot move an old image, and cancelled frames are rejected.
Production overlay reuses the same mechanical shaft geometry and head matrix during electronic multiplane rotation.
